parameter.name: name
parameter.description: Unique name for this Solace connection.

parameter.name: host
parameter.description: Host URL of the Solace broker (e.g., tcp://localhost:55555).

parameter.name: vpnName
parameter.description: Message VPN name (default: 'default').

parameter.name: username
parameter.description: Client username for authentication.

parameter.name: apiProvidedUsername
parameter.description: API-provided username sent to the broker for CLIENT_CERTIFICATE / OAUTH2 schemes (used when the VPN allows api-provided usernames).

parameter.name: password
parameter.description: Client password for authentication.

parameter.name: clientName
parameter.description: Client name for the session.

parameter.name: connectionTimeout
parameter.description: Connection timeout in milliseconds.

parameter.name: readTimeout
parameter.description: Read timeout in milliseconds.

parameter.name: compressionLevel
parameter.description: Compression level (0-9). 0 disables compression.

parameter.name: generateSendTimestamps
parameter.description: Whether to generate send timestamps (true/false).

parameter.name: generateReceiveTimestamps
parameter.description: Whether to generate receive timestamps (true/false).

parameter.name: generateSequenceNumbers
parameter.description: Whether to generate sequence numbers (true/false).

parameter.name: calculateMessageExpiration
parameter.description: Whether to calculate message expiration (true/false).

parameter.name: connectRetries
parameter.description: Number of connection retries.

parameter.name: connectRetriesPerHost
parameter.description: Number of connection retries per host.

parameter.name: reconnectRetries
parameter.description: Number of reconnection retries.

parameter.name: reconnectRetryWait
parameter.description: Wait time between reconnection retries in milliseconds.

parameter.name: sslTrustStorePath
parameter.description: Path to the SSL trust store file.

parameter.name: sslTrustStorePassword
parameter.description: Password for the SSL trust store.

parameter.name: sslTrustStoreFormat
parameter.description: Format of the SSL trust store (e.g., JKS, PKCS12).

parameter.name: sslKeyStorePath
parameter.description: Path to the SSL key store file.

parameter.name: sslKeyStorePassword
parameter.description: Password for the SSL key store.

parameter.name: sslKeyStoreFormat
parameter.description: Format of the SSL key store (e.g., JKS, PKCS12).

parameter.name: sslKeyPassword
parameter.description: Password for the SSL private key.

parameter.name: sslValidateCertificate
parameter.description: Whether to validate the server certificate (true/false).

parameter.name: sslValidateCertificateDate
parameter.description: Whether to validate the certificate date (true/false).

parameter.name: sslValidateHostname
parameter.description: Whether to validate the server hostname against the certificate (true/false).

parameter.name: authenticationScheme
parameter.description: Authentication scheme: BASIC | CLIENT_CERTIFICATE | OAUTH2. Default: BASIC.

parameter.name: oauth2AccessToken
parameter.description: OAuth2 access token (used when authenticationScheme == OAUTH2).

parameter.name: oauth2IssuerIdentifier
parameter.description: OAuth2 issuer identifier (optional, used when authenticationScheme == OAUTH2).

parameter.name: oidcIdToken
parameter.description: OIDC ID token (optional, used when authenticationScheme == OAUTH2).

parameter.name: pubAckWindowSize
parameter.description: Publisher acknowledgement window size for guaranteed messaging (default: 1).

parameter.name: pollAckTimeout
parameter.description: Lease in milliseconds of a message polled with ackMode=CLIENT. When it passes without acknowledgeMessage or nackMessage with target=POLL, the connector settles the message FAILED and the broker redelivers it. Default: 180000.

parameter.name: pollFlowIdleTimeout
parameter.description: Time in milliseconds after which an idle poll flow with no outstanding lease is closed. Default: 60000.

parameter.name: maxPollFlows
parameter.description: Number of poll flows cached per connection, one per queue and selector, each with its own owner thread. Beyond it the least recently used idle flow is evicted, and when none is idle the poll faults with POLL_FLOW_LIMIT. Default: 16.

parameter.name: requireSettlementOutcomes
parameter.description: AUTO or TRUE. The poll flows negotiate the settlement outcomes FAILED and REJECTED with the broker. AUTO retains a message that needs a missing outcome and recycles its flow so the broker redelivers it. TRUE fails the bind when the broker lacks one. Default: AUTO.

parameter.name: maxConcurrentRequests
parameter.description: Number of concurrent sendRequest calls on the connection's request reply session. A call beyond it waits up to its requestTimeout and then faults with REQUEST_CONCURRENCY_EXCEEDED. Default: 100.

parameter.name: recovery.initialDelay
parameter.description: First delay in milliseconds before a failed session is rebuilt. Default: 1000.

parameter.name: recovery.progression
parameter.description: Multiplier applied to the delay after each failed rebuild attempt. Default: 2.0.

parameter.name: recovery.maxDelay
parameter.description: Upper bound in milliseconds of the rebuild delay. Default: 60000.

parameter.name: recovery.maxAttempts
parameter.description: Number of rebuild attempts before the operation faults. -1 means unlimited within the operation's deadline. Default: -1.

parameter.name: clientNameStrict
parameter.description: When true the clientName is sent as given to the first pooled session and the other sessions append their role. When false, the default, every session name is the clientName prefix followed by the node id, the connection name and the session's role. Default: false.

parameter.name: oauth2TokenFile
parameter.description: Path of a file holding the OAuth2 access token. The token is read from the file at every connect and reconnect, so a sidecar can rotate it. Requires authenticationScheme=OAUTH2.

parameter.name: keepAliveInterval
parameter.description: Keep alive interval of the JCSMP sessions in milliseconds. Empty leaves the JCSMP default.

parameter.name: keepAliveLimit
parameter.description: Number of missed keep alive responses after which a JCSMP session is considered lost. Empty leaves the JCSMP default.

parameter.name: maxActiveConnections
parameter.description: Maximum number of pooled sessions. Default: 8. The connection keeps at most twice this number of pooled physical sessions, counting those still connecting or being closed.

parameter.name: maxIdleConnections
parameter.description: Maximum number of idle pooled sessions kept. Default: 8.

parameter.name: maxWaitTime
parameter.description: Time in milliseconds an operation waits for a pooled session before it faults. Zero or a negative value is replaced by the default, because the pool would wait forever. Default: 10000.

parameter.name: minEvictionTime
parameter.description: Time in milliseconds a pooled session may stay idle before the evictor may close it.

parameter.name: evictionCheckInterval
parameter.description: Interval in milliseconds between runs of the pool evictor. Empty leaves the evictor off.

parameter.name: exhaustedAction
parameter.description: What a borrow does when every pooled session is in use. WHEN_EXHAUSTED_BLOCK waits up to maxWaitTime, WHEN_EXHAUSTED_FAIL faults at once, WHEN_EXHAUSTED_GROW creates one more session and removes the limit on pooled physical sessions. Default: WHEN_EXHAUSTED_BLOCK.
